interventions.agent: AAV2/9-SOM-Cre in RIN1fl/fl (RIN1 deletion in SOM+ neurons)

combinations.readout: neuropathic mechanical allodynia and spontaneous pain
combinations.magnitude: after RIN1 deletion TCN-201 less effective than ifenprodil at days 7 and 28, reduced GluN2A inhibitor efficacy especially late
combinations.evidence_quote: Compared to ifenprodil, TCN-201 was less effective in the pain suppression at each time point (Fig 6C–6F), suggesting that the impeded switch following RIN1 deletion reduced the analgesic efficacy of GluN2A inhibition, especially at the later stage of neuropathic pain.
